description:
Spec: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §SpaceRole (commit c3ea5d9, "harden position 0 / @everyone reservation").

Spec text: "Position 0 is reserved for the implicit @everyone role, which every member of a Space holds and which serves as the permission floor; defined SpaceRoles MUST have position > 0."

Current state: crate-jmap-chat-server/src/space.rs accepts position: 0 in addRoles/updateRoles. No validation rejects it. permissions.rs line 154 and 163 already use position: 0 internally for synthetic @everyone, so accepting it on the wire would create real conflicts.

## Acceptance

- handle_space_set in chat-server/src/space.rs validates that every SpacePatchOp::AddRole(role) has role.position > 0
- Same validation for SpacePatchOp::UpdateRole when patch.position is Some(0)
- Rejection emits SetError of type invalidArguments with properties: ["position"] and a description mentioning the @everyone reservation
- Unit test: addRoles with position: 0 returns invalidArguments; addRoles with position: 1 succeeds
- Unit test: updateRoles with patch setting position: 0 returns invalidArguments

## Out of scope

- Injecting implicit @everyone at position 0 in get_objects responses (separate concern; permissions resolver already has this; verify but don't expand)
- Enforcing role-hierarchy (separate, JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 covers it)
title: Layer A: Reject SpaceRole.position == 0 as invalidArguments in Space/set addRoles and updateRoles
